scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply crgs --local && wrangler dev
scripts.submissions:local: wrangler d1 execute crgs --local --command "SELECT id, created_at, town, who, credit_line, length(story) AS story_chars, audio_key, publish_ok, voice_ok, contact_ok FROM submissions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply crgs --remote && wrangler deploy
